# Boats for Sale

![Boats in storage](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1553305061649-2O7C7KFHPNZB93C0QDYI/image-asset.jpeg)

### BUY A BOAT & SUPPORT MARITIME HERITAGE

The Center for Wooden Boats accepts boat donations. Some join our classic wooden boat collection, but most are sold to fund our on-the-water programs for kids. Boats on the docks can be viewed during open hours — ask for the vessel at the Front Desk. Off-site boats require an appointment. Listing descriptions are not guaranteed; buyers should verify details before purchasing.
